overview_description.description:
Companies are now global from day one. The tax & legal admin needed to operate globally compounds with every entity.

To solve this, companies engage external experts (lawyers/tax experts), but their solutions rely on human intervention and create hidden future costs by focusing on a narrow part of the problem, not the whole state of the company.

Caribou is an alternative to working with service providers. By tracking your finances, personnel, and corporate information, we can continuously monitor your entities and prepare the compliance docs you need to operate anywhere in the world legally.

product.name: Intercompany Agreements and Transfer Pricing Policies
product.description: A service that helps multi-entity companies create and manage intragroup agreements and transfer pricing policies to ensure compliance with international tax regulations.

product.name: Entity Monitoring
product.description: A real-time monitoring service that tracks international tax and legal compliance status of a company’s entities as they grow globally.

product.name: Automatic Document Parsing
product.description: A feature that extracts relevant information from uploaded documents to streamline the preparation of transfer pricing and intragroup agreements.

product.name: Multi-Entity Administration Platform
product.description: A platform that allows companies to request transfer pricing documents, manage intragroup agreements, and oversee work across teams for multiple entities.

product.name: Always-On Support
product.description: A support service providing 24/7 access to international tax expertise through communication channels like Slack or Teams without hourly billing.
